versions.changelog:
- Initial release of geo-update skill.
- Provides a streamlined way to update the SEO + GEO toolkit and seogeo CLI to the latest version.
- Automatically detects installed agent tools and reinstalls skills as needed.
- Reports current and latest versions, what changed, and confirms successful updates.
- Preserves all user data and configurations during updates; only bundled skill files are replaced.
- Warns users if local skill files have been edited and may be overwritten during the update.
